item.title: NASCAR: Looking forward after a challenging season in 2025
item.description: It was a difficult year for NASCAR in 2025. There was the antitrust lawsuit and trial over charter status involving 23XI Racing and Front Row Motorsports that got nasty before being settled. Fan displeasure over the playoff format reached its peak. item.title: Jessup VFW Post 5544 donates to local children
item.description: The Jessup VFW Post 5544 collected cash and bought toys for local children, totaling more than $2,500. The Jessup Carbino Club also donated. Seated, from left: Matt Cirba, event co-chairman; Steve Jackowitz, Jessup VFW junior vice commander; Russell Canevari, post commander; Manual Griffin, senior vice commander; and Chris Naticchi, Carbino Club president. Standing: shoppers Joe Fetcho and Amy Schoonover.

item.title: Remember when
item.description: 30 years ago Scranton Prep posted its 20th win of the season, 64-45, over Scranton to win the Lackawanna League Southern Division boys basketball second-half and overall season titles. Chris Glenn had 23 points and 10 rebounds to lead the Cavaliers. John Lyons had 16 points for the Knights. … Mark Sakson scored 29 points, and Bill Celuck added 20 points and 14 rebounds to lead Valley View to a 71-48 win over Mid Valley, as the Cougars captured the Lackawanna League Northern Division title.
